## Description

16–32 green cells (~13 µm) separated at the surface of a mucilage sphere of 50–200 µm: a step between
*Pandorina* and *Volvox* in the volvocine series.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [colony](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#other-colonies) of 32 cells (`hollow_colony` style) that releases
daughter colonies; phototactic. No measured speed: that of *Gonium*.

## Literature

- Butterwick C., Heaney S.I., Talling J.F. (2005) Freshwater Biol. 50: 291 (measured *E. unicocca*:
  ≥ 0.4 divisions/day even at 5 °C; not used for *E. elegans*).
- de Maleprade H. et al. (2020) Phys. Rev. E 101: 022416 (volvocine swimming, via *Gonium*).

## Not implemented yet

- 4 daughter colonies instead of one per cell.
- No anisogamous sexual reproduction.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares daughter colonies with *Gonium*, *Pandorina* and *Volvox*.
